title: Selective Postoperative Creatinine Testing and AKI Model Transport: A Multidatabase Study
description: Corrected, journal-neutral reproducibility package for a multidatabase methodological study of selective postoperative creatinine testing across AKI model development, local recalibration, and post-exploration temporal evaluation. Version v3.3.0 supersedes v3.2.5 for reproducing the revised results: it includes cohort and numerical-threshold corrections, corrected aggregate results and model parameters, paired recalibration comparisons, an aggregate raw-record verification summary, and same-timestamp baseline-selection sensitivity analyses. The package contains analysis code, aggregate tables, figures, model metadata, and reproducibility documentation; it does not contain raw or patient-level data, individual predictions, serialized model objects, manuscripts, or confidential peer-review material. The four-variable model is a methodological probe, not a model approved or validated for clinical deployment. Missing postoperative creatinine does not establish absence of AKI. Same-timestamp sensitivity results are post hoc refitted point estimates in retained cohorts, not clinical adjudication, performance bounds, or evidence of statistical equivalence. The earlier v3.2.5 archive remains available as provenance but does not reproduce the corrected results. Code is MIT-licensed; original documentation, aggregate results, figures, and model metadata are CC BY 4.0. Source datasets retain their own access and redistribution conditions.
